findings.claim: The exclusion states that T10, T12, T47 and the device parts of T26/T49 are listed in D-381 as 'out of v1 scope (user decision)', a status outside D-381's own vocabulary (automated, manual-pending, verified) and outside I-018 ('exist as an automated test or a recorded manual check before the run closes'). The design does not say that I-018 is narrowed for these tests, so I-018 cannot literally be met and a later gate check may fail the run or force a manual-pending entry the user removed.
findings.suggested_fix: State in the carried section that for T10, T12, T47 (and device parts of T26/T49) the user decision replaces I-018's 'recorded manual check' with the 'out of v1 scope (user decision)' entry, and that D-381 gains that fourth status for exactly these rows.

findings.claim: Integration items I-005 ('every module and the Android sample') and I-009 ('Android-only examples compile in the samples/android build') name the removed sample, and the wave design says nothing about them. With no sample, the Android-only examples of docs/api have no compiling build, and the Gson 2.14.0 check has no sample part.
findings.suggested_fix: Add to the carried section: I-005 applies to the root modules only; for I-009 the Android-only examples are either removed from docs/api, marked as not compiled in v1, or covered by the logcat module test, and say which.

findings.claim: D-434 (verbatim) gives as a reason that API 21 TLS testing is 'left to manual device runs by Q-3'. Under the user decision there are no device runs in v1, so the release text written from D-434 would cite a path that was removed. The design does not say how the reason is worded.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a sentence that the release text for D-434 words the second reason as 'separate API 21 TLS provider and certificate testing, which is outside v1 together with device verification (user decision)'.

findings.claim: The header still says the 'device parts of T26 and T49 recorded as manual checks' and the section intro still says 'Answers Q-3 (automated builds, manual device run)', while the carried section says those device parts are 'out of v1 scope'. D-347 (wave 7) also requires a manual follow-up for low-end device tuning in the release test results. The design does not say whether D-347's follow-up remains.
findings.evidence: design.md header paragraph and 'Answers Q-3' line; 00.design.md:605 (D-347)
findings.suggested_fix: Say that the header sentence is superseded by the carried section and state whether D-347's follow-up stays as a plain post-v1 note in D-381 or is folded into the out-of-scope entry.

findings.claim: The header still says the wave covers issue #17 and sub-issue #17 (Android sample, device QA, R8) has no remaining deliverable; the design does not say how #17 is closed, or that the release documentation (not just the carried section) carries the 'not part of v1' statement for D-379/D-383. Only the carried section asserts it, with no item owning it.
findings.evidence: design.md header ('Covers issues #16, #19, #17 and #18'); 01.intake.md:61, 496-515; carried section last sentence
findings.suggested_fix: Name which release item (for example D-379 README or D-381) holds the 'sample and device verification not part of v1' statement, and say how issue #17 is closed or deferred.
